data.report: Friday, November 27, 2026 6:15 AM – Mostly cloudy skies will stick around today, with a light west-southwest breeze, temperatures in the 40s and slightly stronger winds across the upper mountain this afternoon. 19 lifts are expected to spin today, conditions permitting. Expect groomed corduroy, with firmer turns early that will soften as temperatures warm throughout the day. Once the snow loosens up, Saddle Bowl off Face Lift Express (3) is a soft, scenic groomer worth a few laps. Keep in mind that early-season obstacles are still present in some areas, so ski and ride with caution. Tonight, the Holiday Tree Lighting brings Woolly, Santa, live music and kids' activities to The Village from 6 PM to 8:30 PM. Conditions and Visibility: Mostly cloudy skies, a light west-southwest breeze with slightly stronger winds across the upper mountain this afternoon, and temperatures in the 40s. Expect groomed corduroy, with firmer conditions early that should soften throughout the day. Flat light is possible under the cloud cover, so a low-light lens is a smart pick. Another storm cycle is forecast to move into the area starting Sunday. Keep an eye on the storm tracker for the latest updates. Lift Status: 19 lifts are expected to spin today, conditions permitting. Safety: Be aware of early-season obstacles that may still be hidden beneath the snow. Conditions aren't quite like peak season just yet, so stick to open, groomed trails and ride within your ability level . Look uphill and yield to others before starting downhill or merging onto a trail. There is no uphill skiing or skinning access anywhere on the resort at this time . Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is 760.934.0611. Road Conditions: Always be prepared for winter mountain driving and watch for changing road conditions. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest updates.
